cases.name: rev-proc-2012-29-examples-1-and-2
cases.description: Examples 1 and 2 ($25,000 paid at $25,000 FMV): with the election, $0 income at transfer and nothing at vesting, basis $25,000, holding period from transfer; without it, $15,000 compensation at vesting ($40,000 FMV minus $25,000 paid) and basis $40,000.
cases.source: Rev. Proc. 2012-29 § 5 (https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-drop/rp-12-29.pdf): 25,000 shares transferred 2012-04-01, vesting 2014-04-01 at a $40,000 FMV, Examples 1 and 2

cases.name: rev-proc-2012-29-examples-4-and-5
cases.description: Examples 4 and 5 ($0 paid for shares worth $25,000): with the election, $25,000 compensation at transfer and basis $25,000; without it, $40,000 compensation at vesting and basis $40,000.
cases.source: Rev. Proc. 2012-29 § 5 (https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-drop/rp-12-29.pdf): 25,000 shares transferred 2012-04-01, vesting 2014-04-01 at a $40,000 FMV, Examples 4 and 5
